REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - JULY 9, 2020 -
07:00 P.M.
TELECONFERENCE MEETING AUTHORIZED BY STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20 VIA ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID #831 7628 7983
*COVID-19 NOTICE*
To protect public health and safety during the local, state, and federally declared COVID-19 emergency, the City Council Chamber and City Hall are closed to the public. Consistent with State of California Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the Los Angeles County Health Officer’s “Safer at Home Order for Control of COVID-19” the City Council will participate in the meeting through teleconference. Public participation in the meeting will be facilitated through the electronic methods as described below.
Agenda Materials:
The agenda and agenda packet related to items on this agenda are available for public inspection at www.cerritos.us. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet will be made available for public inspection at www.cerritos.us.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION:
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us and on Cerritos TV3.
Public Comments:
Members of the public may provide public comment through the following methods:
Email: Members of the public may provide public comment by submitting an email to city_clerk@cerritos.us by 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the meeting date and agenda item number for which you would like to provide comment in the subject line of the email. The public comment will be distributed to all members of the City Council. During the meeting your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Teleconference Participation: You may provide audio public comment by connecting to the teleconference meeting online or by telephone/mobile call (please select only one method). Public speakers will be queued to provide comment at the appropriate time on the agenda. You must be available to provide comment at the time you are called upon to speak. If you are not planning on providing public comment we encourage you to observe the meeting via livestream or on Cerritos TV3 to allow staff to more effectively manage the number of teleconference connections.
Cerritos Zoom meeting online link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83176287983
Cerritos Zoom Meeting call-in telephone number: (669) 900-6833
Cerritos Zoom Meeting ID: 831 7628 7983
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations:
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk/Treasurer at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the teleconference meeting.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
THURSDAY, JULY 9, 2020, 7:00 P.M., TELECONFERENCED MEETING AUTHORIZED BY
STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20, VIA ZOOM
VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID# 831 7628 7983

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor Naresh Solanki.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Bruce Barrows
  Council/Agency Member Grace Hu
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Chuong Vo
  Mayor/Chair Naresh Solanki

5.  Presentations/Appointments

  None.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to speak, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

7.  Consent Calendar

7A.  Approval of Minutes

  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Adjourned Special Meeting Minutes of
  June 22, 2020 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Vo, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Adjourned Special Meeting Minutes of June 22, 2020
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  July 9, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 2 of 5

7.  Consent Calendar (continued)

7A.  (continued)

  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of June 25,
  2020 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Vo, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of June 25, 2020
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands

7B.1. Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated July 9, 2020
  (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Vo, to approve the Register of
  Demands, as follows:

  City of Cerritos  7/9/2020  $3,585,753.62 (COUNCIL)

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7C.  Approval of Treasurer’s Reports

  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Treasurer’s Reports for the period
  ending May 31, 2020 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Vo, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Treasurer’s Reports for the period ending May 31, 2020
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Public Hearings

  None.
 City of Cerritos  July 9, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 3 of 5

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of an informational update on the City’s response to the
  COVID-19 local emergency (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Annie Hylton, City & Theater Marketing Manager/City
  Librarian. A PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to speak, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

  There was no further action taken on this item.

9B.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and introduce AN ORDINANCE OF
  THE CITY OF CERRITOS REPEALING CHAPTER 2.22 OF THE CERRTIOS MUNICIPAL
  CODE, THEREBY DISSOLVING THE CITY OF CERRITOS ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT
  COMMISSION (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kristin Aguila, Advance Planning Manager. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Sam Desai requested the City Council provide economic opportunities for all
  businesses in Cerritos, particularly small businesses.

  Noting there were no other individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor declared the
  public comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Hu, and seconded by Vo, to waive full reading of and
  introduce Ordinance No. 1033, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
  REPEALING CHAPTER 2.22 OF THE CERRTIOS MUNICIPAL CODE, THEREBY
  DISSOLVING THE CITY OF CERRITOS ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT
  COMMISSION (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9C.  Review and consideration of an informational report to the Cerritos City Council
  concerning the potential formation of an advisory body for the ongoing review of the
  annual budget and audit compliance (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Ryan Carey, Finance Manager. A PowerPoint presentation
  was displayed.

  The Mayor opened public comments.

  Sam Desai spoke in opposition to the creation of a budget and audit compliance
  advisory body.

  Noting there were no other individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor declared the
  public comments period closed.
 City of Cerritos  July 9, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 4 of 5

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9C.  (continued)

  MOTION: It was moved by Hu, and seconded by Barrows, to approve Option No. 4 as
  recommended in the agenda report, to regularly schedule an agenda item that would
  provide the City Council with an opportunity to review the City’s annual budget while
  simultaneously ensuring audit compliance. The reports would be inclusive of the
  quarterly economic development reports which were previously provided to the
  Economic Development Commission, a detailed review of the City’s annual budget,
  items that are taking place on the finance calendar, updates on audit and budget
  preparations, investment policy/activity, and other items of significance (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  MOTION: It was moved by Hu, and seconded by Vo, to require the budget and audit
  compliance report to be placed on the City Council agenda on a quarterly basis
  (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (4 – 1) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  Yokoyama
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

10.  Legislative Items

10A.  Report on pending legislation.

  None.

10B.  Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State or
  Federal legislature or in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature.

  None.

11.  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings

  Reports were provided by Councilmembers Barrows, Hu and Yokoyama, Mayor Pro
  Tem Vo and Mayor Solanki.

  CONSENSUS (Barrows): The Mayor approved an ad hoc City Charter review
  committee, led by Councilmember Barrows, to include former Councilmembers and
  with community meetings, if needed, in the future.

  CONSENSUS (Vo): Directed the City Manager to provide an updated report
  regarding the status of the pine tree removal and reforestation program.

  CONSENSUS (Vo): The Mayor established an ad hoc City-wide Policies and
  Procedures committee, led by Mayor Pro Tem Vo, with Councilmember Barrows
  serving as alternate.
 City of Cerritos  July 9, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 5 of 5

11.  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings
  (continued)

  CONSENSUS (Solanki): The Mayor established an ad hoc City Protocol Manual
  committee, led by Councilmember Barrows, with Mayor Pro Tem Vo serving as
  alternate.

12.  Closed Session

  City Attorney Mark Steres announced that the City Council would recess to Closed
  Session to discuss items 12A, 12B, 12C, 12D, and 12E on the Closed Session
  agenda. An announcement regarding any reportable action resulting from the Closed
  Session would be made at the next City Council/Successor Agency meeting.

12A.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Manager

12B.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Attorney

12C.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Clerk/Treasurer

12D. CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957.6 (COUNCIL)
  Agency Negotiators: Art Gallucci, Patricia Leyva, and Charles Goldstein
  Employee Organization: AFSCME, Local 619

12E.  CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957.6 (COUNCIL)
  Agency Negotiators: Art Gallucci and Charles Goldstein
  Unrepresented Employees: Full-Time Exempt

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 10:00 p.m. The report for any Closed Session matters
  considered under Item 12 as listed on this agenda will be announced at the July
  23, 2020 City Council/Successor Agency regular meeting.

ATTEST:

  /s/Vida Barone
  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Agency Secretary

/s/Naresh Solanki
Naresh Solanki, Mayor/Chair

APPROVED: July 23, 2020
